observations.body: Gideon said, “Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Gideon answers Succoth while pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna.
observations.label: Refusal during pursuit

observations.body: A town at the wilderness edge refuses food to exhausted pursuers.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Judges 8:5–9 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Gideon’s need is immediate, but his threatened return carries the scene beyond the request.
payload.title: A wilderness threat after battle
